title: Pure Emerald Tools
description: A Mod that adding Emerald Tools in the Game
body:
# 💎 Pure Emerald Tools
### *Experience the power of the purest emerald – from the pickaxe to the armor.*

> A complete set of emerald-based tools, weapons and armor — each with unique abilities that take your gameplay to the next level.

---

## 📖 Description

**Pure Emerald Tools** expands your Minecraft world with a complete set of emerald-based items – from reliable everyday tools to powerful armor. Each item has been carefully crafted and comes with unique abilities that take your gameplay to the next level.

Whether you're mining deep underground, exploring dangerous biomes, or holding your own in combat – with Pure Emerald Tools, you're always well equipped.

---

## ⚒️ Content

### 🔧 Tools

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| **Emerald Pickaxe** | Mine faster than ever with pure emerald. |
| **Emerald Axe** | Chop through wood like it's nothing. |
| **Emerald Shovel** | Dig with emerald precision. |
| **Emerald Hoe** | Till the land in style. |
| **Emerald Sword** | Strike down your enemies with emerald power. |
| **Emerald Shears** | Cut with the sharpest emerald edge. |

### 🛡️ Armor

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| **Emerald Helmet** | Protect your head with pure emerald. |
| **Emerald Chestplate** | The strongest emerald protection for your torso. |
| **Emerald Leggings** | Stay mobile while staying protected. |
| **Emerald Boots** | Walk the world in emerald confidence. |

### 🖌️ Other

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| **Totem of Emerald** | A powerful totem forged from pure emerald. |
| **Totem Repair Table** | Repair your totem and keep its power alive. |
| **Emerald Shield Painting** | Decorate your world with emerald art. |

---

## ✨ Special Abilities

Many items come with **unique passive or active abilities** that set them apart from ordinary tools. Explore and discover what each item has to offer!

> 💡 *Tip: Try out all the items — some abilities might just surprise you.*

---

| Property | Info |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft Version** | 1.21.1 |
| **Mod Loader** | NeoForge |
| **Dependencies** | None |
